title: Long-arm authorization
summary: A long-arm statute authorizes jurisdiction over persons outside the state in defined circumstances. Its interpretation determines the state-law reach before constitutional limits are applied.
notes: Some statutes may reach the constitutional limit; others may be narrower.

sections.Meaning: A long-arm statute authorizes jurisdiction over persons outside the state in defined circumstances. Its interpretation determines the state-law reach before constitutional limits are applied.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the precise statutory provision, the conduct alleged to satisfy it, and the state court’s construction. Gray separates interpretation of the place of the tortious act from the due-process analysis.
